description_one_sentence: The list of everyone who has an account with ShopFast, with their name, contact details, birth date, home address and loyalty level.
issues_spotted: 8 duplicated customer rows; 48 missing and 28 invalid emails (5 with a double @); 30 missing phones; birth_date and signup_date in mixed formats (and a few impossible years like 1899 or 2031); country written 18 different ways (FR, France, fr, FRA...); loyalty_tier with case/typo variants (GOLD, Platinium); 48 postal codes with 4 digits

description_one_sentence: The catalogue of items ShopFast sells, with their name, category, price and supplier.
issues_spotted: 1 missing price and 1 negative price; SKU SF-FAS-0522 used by two different products; category written inconsistently (trailing spaces, electronics/SPORTS case)

description_one_sentence: One line per purchase made by a customer, with the date, status, sales channel, delivery country and total amount.
issues_spotted: 7 duplicated orders; 11 missing dates and 5 dates in the future; 14 orders pointing to unknown customers; 6 amounts <= 0; status written inconsistently (Delivered, SHIPPED, canceled/cancelled); total does not match sum of items for 876 orders

description_one_sentence: The detail of what was bought in each order: which product, how many and at what price.
issues_spotted: 4 lines with unknown product 999; 8 lines with quantity 0 or negative; 65 probable duplicate lines; 331 lines whose price differs from the catalogue price

description_one_sentence: Records of how and when each order was paid (card, PayPal, transfer...), the amount, and whether it was refunded.
issues_spotted: card_last4 filled for non-card methods (PayPal, Apple Pay, bank transfer); 6 payment amounts differ from the order total; 298 orders have no payment (297 pending, 1 shipped - the shipped one to be checked)

description_one_sentence: The requests and complaints sent by customers to customer service, with the message and the agent's notes.
issues_spotted: Free text contains personal data: 53 IBANs, 26 full card numbers, phone numbers, emails and birth dates in agent notes; subject often does not match the message; 62 duplicated messages

description_one_sentence: The list of customers selected for the spring 2026 marketing campaign, with their email and loyalty level.
issues_spotted: 29 emails and 5 loyalty tiers differ from customers.csv; no consent flag in the export (should be checked against marketing_consent in customers)
